phrases.画面稳、一人、侧或斜后，才能判定阶段。: Stable follow-cam, one skier, side or rear-quarter.
phrases.跟拍手机，画面尽量只框一名双板滑者。: Follow-cam; one alpine skier in frame.
phrases.从侧面或斜后方拍完整段，少遮挡、光线足够。: Side or rear-quarter, whole run, little occlusion.
phrases.不要边滑边剧烈甩镜头，否则阶段无法判定。: Avoid wild camera motion or the stage cannot be judged.
phrases.踝膝髋微屈，重心在脚心，不后坐。: Soft ankles, knees, and hips; center of mass over mid-foot.
phrases.标准：侧面看髋在踝上方，膝不锁死。: Standard: hip over ankle in profile; knees unlocked.
phrases.练独立压腿，为半犁收板和卡宾外侧腿做准备。: Single-leg strength for the christie close and carve outside ski.
phrases.标准：膝沿脚尖，骨盆不左右倾倒。: Standard: knees track over the toes; pelvis level.
phrases.双腿深蹲 3×8；保加利亚分腿蹲每侧 3×6。: 3×8 squats; Bulgarian split squat 3×6 each side.
phrases.用开角和立刃把速度关死，不靠摔倒。: Open the tails and edge to a stop; do not sit down.
phrases.标准：十次停下板头始终相对、上身对山下。: Standard: ten stops, tips close, torso facing downhill.
phrases.绿道犁式直滑，匀速后再推开板尾立刃停下。: Wedge-glide on a green run, then open the tails and edge to a stop.
phrases.在仍能刹车的前提下划浅 C，外侧板承重。: Shallow C-turns while the wedge still brakes; load the outside ski.
phrases.标准：连续 S 迹，不冲道边；弯中犁式不消失。: Standard: linked S-track, no dart to the edge; the wedge stays through the turn.
phrases.斜滑降开始，外侧加压划小 C，再换另一侧。: From a traverse, pressure the outside ski through a small C, then switch sides.
phrases.用腿和髋改变板向，肩不要当方向盘。: Legs and hips steer; do not use the shoulders as a steering wheel.
phrases.标准：板开始转时肩仍大体对山下。: Standard: the skis start to turn while the shoulders still face downhill.
phrases.陆上模拟：微屈站，左右髋内旋带动脚尖，肩不动。: On land: athletic stance, rotate the femurs to turn the toes, keep the shoulders still.
phrases.入弯犁、出弯逐渐并板，禁止突然并死。: Wedge to start, gradually match at the finish; do not snap shut.
phrases.标准：出弯后半段站距变小，但不失稳。: Standard: stance narrows in the last third of the turn, still stable.
phrases.绿/蓝道做 8 个弯，只在出弯收板。: Eight turns on green or blue; close the ski only at the finish.
phrases.杖尖低、手在视野前下方，给左右节拍。: Pole tips low; hands in the lower visual field for left-right timing.
phrases.标准：回放里手腕不高于肩。: Standard: on replay, the wrists stay below the shoulders.
phrases.缓坡平行或犁式，每弯轻点山下杖。: Easy slope, parallel or wedge: tap the downhill pole each turn.
phrases.平行板横切急停，搓雪小弯的必过刹车。: Matched-ski sideslip stop; required braking for short skidded turns.
phrases.标准：左右都能停在预定点，板平行、不犁开。: Standard: stop on a mark both ways; skis parallel, not in a wedge.
phrases.绿道斜滑降，点杖后双板同时横过来立刃停下。: From a green-run traverse, plant, match both skis, and edge to a stop.
phrases.每侧 8 次；速度一起来先回到斜滑再刹。: Eight each side; if speed builds, reset to a traverse before stopping.
phrases.平行板快速左右转换控速，允许刃搓混合。: Linked short skids on parallel skis; mixed edge and skid is acceptable.
phrases.标准：弯与弯之间没有长横切；膝有屈伸。: Standard: no long traverse between turns; knees flex and extend.
phrases.蓝道平整处 10 个短弯一组，肩静手低。: Ten short turns on a blue groomer; quiet shoulders, hands low.
phrases.标准：缓坡外侧板滑一段，内侧板轻点雪不承重。: Standard: glide on the outside ski; the inside ski taps the snow without taking weight.
phrases.每侧 6 次斜滑降；失稳就放回双脚，不要硬撑。: Six traverses per side; put the ski down if you wobble.
phrases.把弯做圆，让板有机会走刃（启发式，非 FIS）。: Round the turn so the ski can bend (heuristic, not FIS).
phrases.标准：髋向弯心倾，肩不甩；站距保持平行。: Standard: hips incline into the turn, shoulders quiet, stance parallel.
phrases.中等坡画 6 个大 C，外侧腿更长。: Six large C-turns on a moderate pitch; longer outside leg.
phrases.在大弯能倾之后缩短半径。: Shorten the radius only after long-radius inclination works.
phrases.标准：换刃点清楚，不直立横刮。: Standard: a clear edge change, not an upright scrape.
phrases.同一坡面 8 个中弯，频率高于大弯、低于小弯。: Eight medium turns on the same pitch; cadence between long and short.
phrases.快换刃但平行与内倾不能丢。: Faster edge changes without losing parallel inclination.
phrases.标准：左右对称，肩更静。: Standard: left-right symmetry, even quieter shoulders.
phrases.组数少、质量高，避免以疲劳换变形。: Few high-quality sets; do not train fatigue into poor form.
phrases.包顶变短、沟槽变高，用腿贴雪，不要跳。: Shorten at the crest, lengthen in the trough; stay on snow, do not jump.
phrases.标准：上身相对静，膝屈振幅大，落地不砸直腿。: Standard: quiet torso, large knee travel, no straight-leg slam.
phrases.选圆而浅的包沿沟直滑 8 次。: Eight straight lines over round, shallow bumps.
phrases.少横切，连续吸收，仍不开空中评分。: Fewer traverses, linked absorption; still no air scoring.
phrases.标准：髋横摆相对高度变化不大，膝仍在做功。: Standard: hips stay near the fall line; the knees still do the work.
phrases.八到十二个包一组，累了就停。: Sets of 8–12 bumps; stop when form fades.
phrases.板头近、板尾开，站距宽于髋。: Tips close, tails open, stance wider than the hips.
phrases.膝踝有弹性，不锁直。: Elastic knees and ankles; not locked.
phrases.髋在脚上方，压力送到板刃。: Hips over the feet; pressure into the ski.
phrases.膝沿脚尖，不要过度 A 字内扣。: Knees over the toes; avoid a collapsed A-frame.
phrases.转弯中仍保持犁式，外侧承重。: Stay in a wedge through the turn; load the outside ski.
phrases.启发式：膝相对踝内收，用腿转向。: Heuristic: knees inside the ankles; steer with the legs.
phrases.入弯略降重心，膝有弹性。: Slightly lower in the turn; elastic knees.
phrases.有左右转向，不是一条直线冲坡。: Left-right turns, not a straight schuss.
phrases.肩不要跟着板狂转。: Do not spin the shoulders with the skis.
phrases.2D 头关键点不可靠则不计分。: Unscored when the head is not visible in 2D pose.
phrases.站距有开合，不是全程死犁。: Stance width varies; not a locked wedge the whole turn.
phrases.平均站距介于大犁与平行之间。: Mean stance between a full wedge and parallel.
phrases.站距约髋宽，过宽说明犁式残渣。: About hip width; too wide is leftover wedge.
phrases.腿动、上身相对安静。: Legs move; the torso stays quieter.
phrases.不后坐，才能把重量交给新的外侧板。: Stay centered so you can move onto the new outside ski.
phrases.搓雪必须能用平行板急停；用膝屈振幅作代理。: Skidded turns require a matched-ski stop; knee-flex amplitude is the proxy.
phrases.内倾启发式：肩相对髋向弯心。非 FIS 刃角。: Inclination heuristic: shoulders inside the hips toward the turn. Not a FIS edge angle.
phrases.站距保持平行，否则倾会变成内倒。: Stay parallel or inclination becomes banking.
phrases.甩肩会毁掉倾的几何。: Throwing the shoulders wrecks the inclination geometry.
phrases.膝屈振幅大，贴雪而不是跳。: Large knee travel; stay on snow rather than jumping.
phrases.让腿做功。: Let the legs do the work.
phrases.髋横摆相对高度变化的代理，弱信号。: Weak proxy: hip sway versus vertical travel.
phrases.用犁式板形直线下山并主动停下。: Glide straight in a wedge and stop on purpose.
phrases.浅弧 C 弯，髋内旋导向，弯中保持犁。: Shallow C-turns; hip internal rotation steers; the wedge stays.
phrases.入弯犁、出弯收内侧板。: Wedge to start, close the inside ski to finish.
phrases.双板平行，上下分离。过关后可选搓雪或卡宾大弯。: Matched skis and separation. After passing, choose short skids or long-radius carve.
phrases.短半径搓雪控速；必须掌握冰球刹。过关可进蘑菇。: Short-radius skids for speed control; hockey stop required. Then moguls.
phrases.启发式内倾与平行，非 FIS。最好先掌握单脚滑。: Heuristic inclination and parallel stance, not FIS. Learn one-ski first.
phrases.快换刃，肩更静。平整道卡宾枝终点。: Fast edge change, quieter shoulders. End of the groomed carve branch.
phrases.从搓雪枝进入：先吸收贴雪，不要跳。: From the skid branch: absorb and stay on snow; do not jump.
phrases.少横切的连续吸收。不评空中。: Linked absorption near the fall line. No air score.
phrases.目录节点：2D 骨骼不评空中与板尖。请线下教练。: Catalog only: 2D pose does not score air or ski tips. Train with a coach.
phrases.目录节点：箱、杆、跳台不自动打分。: Catalog only: boxes, rails, and jumps are not scored.
phrases.目录节点：本 App 不做旗门计时。: Catalog only: this app does not time gates.
phrases.目录节点：v2 视频不自动判定倒滑。: Catalog only: v2 video does not classify switch.
phrases.滑雪教练启发式，非 FIS 裁判分，非医疗建议。2D 骨骼会误判。疼痛或旧伤请线: Coach heuristics, not FIS judging or medical advice. 2D pose can misread. Pain or prior injury: see a coach or clinician.
phrases.镜头不稳、遮挡或非本课程种类时不判定阶段。: Unstable camera, occlusion, or out-of-scope terrain: no stage claim.
phrases.绿道建议场地，非坡度实测。: Suggested green terrain; slope is not measured.
phrases.蓝道建议场地，非坡度实测。: Suggested blue terrain; slope is not measured.
phrases.红道建议场地，非坡度实测。: Suggested red terrain; slope is not measured.
phrases.黑道建议场地，非坡度实测。: Suggested black terrain; slope is not measured.
phrases.公园建议场地，本 App 不评空中。: Suggested park terrain; this app does not score air.
phrases.蘑菇场地建议，非包型实测。: Suggested mogul field; bump shape is not measured.
phrases.空、缓、人少的绿道，先把刹车练稳。: Quiet, easy green groomer; own the brake first.
phrases.选最缓的坡，避开冰面和拥挤出口。: Pick the gentlest pitch; avoid ice and crowded runouts.
phrases.中等坡平整道，适合平行、搓雪和大弯。: Moderate groomed blue; for parallel, skids, and long-radius carve.
phrases.人少、雪软一点更好；冰面减小弯深。: Prefer fewer people and softer snow; shallower turns on ice.
phrases.更陡的平整道，适合中小弯卡宾启发式。: Steeper groomed red; for medium and short carve heuristics.
phrases.先在蓝道能倾再上红道；累了换缓坡。: Incline on blue before red; move easier when form fades.
phrases.仅在蘑菇落差线课使用的陡/难建议，仍非实测。: Steep/hard suggestion for fall-line moguls only; still not measured.
phrases.包圆、线空、能看到沟；不要为了黑道硬上。: Round bumps, an open line, visible troughs; do not force a black run.
phrases.圆而浅的包，先直滑吸收。: Round, shallow bumps; absorb in a straight line first.
phrases.避开尖包、跳台和过窄的线。: Avoid sharp bumps, jumps, and a too-narrow line.
phrases.目录课：箱杆跳台请线下教练，软件不打分。: Catalog: boxes, rails, and jumps with a coach; the app does not score them.
phrases.只在有教练和防护的公园区域尝试。: Only try park features with a coach and protection.
phrases.室内或平地，练站姿和单腿力量。: Indoors or flat ground for stance and single-leg strength.
phrases.防滑地面，旁边有扶手更好。: Non-slip floor; a handhold nearby helps.
